nom: MEDIHEAL Retinol Collagen Eye Ampoule Patch

avis.texte: This product helps with breathing under your eye and makes it more effective. Helps with your puffiness go away. I use it every morning.
These feel nice going on, but that's it, they do absolutely nothing! I will use them up because I paid $ for them, but will not repurchase. Pass!

I do not often leave bad reviews but this product left me disappointed. Disturbed even. I received these eye masks yesterday and excitedly tried them this morning. I had a clean, bare face and no products were used before or after. The eye masks themselves feel lovely while applied and were easy to tolerate for the 20-30 min recommended application. It's the afterward that's the problem. Approximately 45 mins after removing them, I touched my face to check how my face felt; was it moisturized and did the excess absorb well. Just by simply running my fingers over my skin, I created the worst pilling I've experienced in my life while using beauty products (the picture I'm uploading shows only a fraction because most of it came off on my fingers). It literally felt like my skin was sloughing off. There was absolutely NO WAY I was going to be able to apply moisturizer, sunscreen, or makeup to prepare for work this morning. I had to waste my cleanser to cleanse my face for the second time just so I could remove all the eye mask residue and start my routine over. So disappointing. Also, I've been on the hunt for good quality eye masks that are affordable. I landed on these based on positive reviews, it being a trusted Korean beauty brand, and the sale price. I suppose it just goes to show that reviews aren't an accurate representation of how a product will perform for you (that, and/or the reviews are bought…guess we'll never know).

Its not bad… still feels refreshing on the eyes but i think most people (myself included) like to put this on before makeup and it PILLS. Super goopy and leaves a lot of residue. If you planned on wearing it before bed it might be ok but otherwise i wouldnt recommend.

didn't notice a difference in using these. theyre just an accessory at this point. also, the residue is left on my skin and leaves peeling. when i do my makeup i have to PEEL it off. i've used better.

I have genetic teardrop lines under my eyes, and these patches made them practically disappear. I have purchased many different eyepatch and cream brands over the past 6 or so years and nothing seems to work, until I found these. I highly recommend.

These eye patches were just so goopy because of the serum it's soaked in. They slide down your eyes because of all the slime. I made the mistake of trying to wear these before I did my makeup. Once I took them off, the leftover serum started to pill on my face. There was no way I could apply makeup on top of that, so I ended up having to wipe it off.

avis.titre: Good product but it pulls around the eyes
avis.texte: I really like these patches and I feel like they do what they say they're gonna. Definitely lifted and brightened my eyes so I like to use them for my skincare before makeup application. However this creates little pills at some point and you have to wipe under your eyes after removing them. Still debating if I'll return or just wait till I'm done before chucking them.

I loved the product. Get a margarita put them on and relax. I left mines on for 40 mins even though it recommended 20-30. There was a slight resedue but it was fine. I have noticed a difference when using them m. I definitely recommend trying them.
I really like how bright your skin looks , and fresh it feels the next morning.

These eye patches are a slimy mess. By the time you get them on your eyes, the serum is all over your hands and the container, even with the spoolie. After application, they leave a residue under your eyes that pills in a way that makes you want to peel it off like dry glue. I've had to wash my face afterward, which defeats the entire purpose.
Would definitely recommend. Easy to use. Noticeably removes wrinkles after a few applications.

The reviews on this were the reason why I purchased the item. I was excited to try this. However, after I removed the eyepatch, I was left with a ton of residue, as if I use a skin exfoliation. The entire box is covered in Chinese letters. I was unable to read anything on the box.

I've been trying out different eye patches lately and saw these ones had great reviews so figured I'd give them a try since I recently ran out. I honestly hate them. I can see how people would like them but for me they're too much of a hassle and a mess. There's way too much product on each eye patch so when I take one out it drips all over the place. They're also way too big for my eyes, I have to trim off the tip so it doesn't poke my eye. I constantly have to readjust them because they slide down my face and this all would be worth it if I saw any kind of a difference in my under eyes but I haven't (I'm about 3/4 of the way through the package). Any initial results are temporary, most likely because they're cooling (which admittedly does feel nice but I can get the same result sitting with ice wrapped in a paper towel for 5 min). I saw another review say the serum pills on their face and yep it does that to me too. I'm glad these work for so many people but I personally can't wait to be done with them so I can go back to eye patches I actually like.

avis.titre: Hard to give a great review first week of use
avis.texte: Its not the best undereye moisture patch, but it maybe slightly helps. I get puffy undereyes sometimes in the morning and started getting small undereye creases with age. Only slightly helps with both of those, and I've used better from other brands. Likely won't repurchase again.

It felt very luxe going on. They're basically clear, and have a lot of serum on it. I noticed within 15 minutes the serum was basically gone. I had residual tackiness that didn't go away after removal. Also (the worst part) is that the serum wouldn't stop pilling. No matter how long I wore the masks, bare-faced or moisturized, it always pilled. Even my husband noticed too.

It works! Feels smooth, relaxing, and when you take it off. Noticeable difference in wrinkles around the eyes. I am 52 years old, breast cancer survivor ; 5 years of chemotherapy. Skin is very sensitive all Mediheal products work on my skin don't irritate it in anyway. Thank you! Try it you're worth it, you won't regret it!
1st time using it and it refreshes my user eye. I use it it the morning before I put my make up on whenever I go out.

I've been using these eye patches for a while and managed to snag them at a great price with a shipping deal! I'm concerned about the wrinkles around my eyes, and while I can't say I've seen results yet, I think consistent use is key. Like most gel masks, these have excellent adherence to the skin. There's nothing particularly disappointing about this product, so I'm at a loss for words to fill this section.
I am super satisfied with this product. I use it for my eye wrinkles and am happy with it!

avis.titre: I've been using this for a...
avis.texte: I've been using this for a year now, and I can definitely say that consistent use shows results. Since it's a collagen ampoule patch, it doesn't feel drying even when left on for a long time. I love how you can feel it getting thinner as it absorbs into the skin! After applying, some of the collagen ampoule tends to pill and peel off, so it's better to use before bed rather than before makeup or going out. It's hard to expect dramatic or immediate effects, and the results don't last very long!

It's moisturizing and gentle on the skin. I'm definitely considering repurchasing! It's slippery, so it tends to slide down after application. Also, it's difficult to take out just one sheet at a time.
The patches adhered gently to the eye area and stayed put even with movement. While it felt moisturizing immediately after use, the hydration didn't seem to last for very long.

The gel patches are wonderfully hydrating! They're so discreet, you can barely tell they're on. Perfect for moisturizing around the eyes during my morning commute when I'm in a rush! If I had to find a fault, it might be that separating individual patches can be a bit tricky. Just a heads up ­ if your skin is already moisturized, these patches might slide down a bit when placed above the eyes. For best results, I recommend using them while lying down before bed to deeply hydrate the eye area.

I've tried various types of patches, but I think this might be the best product in terms of convenience. The spoon (which is great because it's not tweezers) is perfect for scooping up just one patch, and I love that the contents don't drip but absorb directly into the skin. I've always been concerned about vertical lines under my eyes due to my habit of sleeping on one side, but with consistent use, I've definitely noticed less creasing after applying makeup. Since it's a patch that goes right under the eyes, I appreciate that it's a product with almost no scent or color, which I've been using well for a long time. There's not really anything to complain about, except maybe that the amount is small, so if you use it daily, you'll go through one container in a month...? After the toner step, I apply it directly under my eyes and remove it after about 10 minutes. When the jelly patch has released all its collagen, the outer surface starts to dry up, and that's the perfect time to remove it.

It's moisturizing and contains retinol, which helps with fine lines It slips off easily and doesn't stay in place well. I have to reapply it every time it slides down It works better if you apply it while lying down. Make sure to remove the patch before it dries completely to avoid skin dryness

avis.titre: I tried my mom's, and it's...
avis.texte: I tried my mom's, and it's incredibly thin, adhering perfectly to the skin. They've enhanced absorption with low molecular weight collagen, and I love that it even has a brightening effect around the eyes. It's so thin that it can tear easily if you're not careful, which is a bit disappointing. However, I have no complaints about its nourishing properties. Using it frequently would probably give the best results, right? I apply it daily as a replacement for eye cream.

I keep these in the refrigerator and use before my bedtime routine. I like the fact that they stay on without slipping off and I really think they do work on fine lines around the eyes. The fact that they're smaller particles of retinol is especially appealing as far as absorption. But I highly recommend these and use them all the time.

avis.titre: I've been using this for about...
avis.texte: I've been using this for about a year now. It's moisturizing and leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth. Even though I have sensitive skin, I experience no irritation. As time passes, it absorbs well and becomes thinner. The absorption speed seems to vary from person to person ­ those with dry skin might find it thins out much faster. Once it's thin enough, you can just peel it off. There's a built­in spoon­like tool, but it doesn't scoop out the product well, which is a bit disappointing from a hygiene perspective. The case color seems to have changed now, but I'm not sure if that's actually a new design or not. Don't forget to apply it to your nasolabial folds too. While the effects might not be immediately noticeable, I believe it's working its magic.
While it doesn't deliver dramatic results, it's still quite nice There's nothing particularly disappointing about it. It's great to apply before bed at night

I've been using these eye patches for over a month now. While I don't use them daily, I apply them when I wake up looking tired or with dark circles under my eyes. The patches are incredibly hydrating, making the fine lines under my eyes less noticeable. They're infused with collagen, niacinamide, and a touch of retinol. The first few times I used them, I experienced a slight tingling sensation, but I suspect it was due to the retinol I use at night. I soak the patches thoroughly in the serum and leave them on my face for 15 minutes.

avis.titre: Here's my review after a month...
avis.texte: Here's my review after a month of use: I bought these patches after hearing they're good for smile lines. I can definitely say that when I apply makeup the next day after using them, there's less creasing in those areas. Plus, they stay put really well, so you can just stick them on and go about your day. When you remove them, there's a strange, uncomfortable feeling and some dryness, so I apply an additional layer of emulsion to that area.
Absolutely fantastic. As expected from Mediheal. It's so hydrating and wonderful! Truly nice. Hmm... I can't really think of any downsides. Everything was great.

avis.titre: If your eyes tend to get puffy...
avis.texte: If your eyes tend to get puffy and you have some extra time in the morning, this is perfect for reducing that swelling. I'm so pleased that Bring Green products generally work well with my skin. The generous amount of ampoule in this product is a real bonus ­ I've been using it happily. There's quite a lot of ampoule, so you need to lie down while wearing the patches. Otherwise, it tends to drip down.

Convenient to apply under the eyes before bed. The under­eye area has thin, often dry skin. Applying rich creams there can sometimes cause milia or make your eyes water if the product gets in. These eye patches are not only convenient but also practical and effective. Although they're called retinol patches, the retinol content seems low, as its effects are minimal.

avis.titre: To be honest, I can't say I've...
avis.texte: To be honest, I can't say I've noticed any dramatic effects, but I think it would be great to use consistently for preventive care! I didn't find anything disappointing about it. It caused minimal irritation and didn't lead to any blemishes.

I bought this because it contains retinol. I keep it in the fridge and apply it under my eyes and around my nose every night. It feels refreshingly cool, which I really enjoy! The downside is that the lid opens too easily, so I have to hold the entire case to feel secure when using it. I'm not sure about its wrinkle­reducing effects, so I apply retinol cream first and then put this on top.
The gel­type patch adheres wonderfully to the skin, and after using it, my skin feels noticeably firmer! Be cautious if your skin doesn't agree with retinol, as it may cause redness or blemishes!

avis.titre: I applied it under my eyes and...
avis.texte: I applied it under my eyes and then layered another patch on top. It's decent, so I don't have any particular complaints. It's just average. I'm not sure if it actually has any effect.

I repurchased these because my mom only uses Mediheal eye patches! I tried them too, and they're packed with essence­like content. The patches are nice and firm, and there are plenty in the pack, so they'll last a while. Nothing particularly bad to mention. I bought them when they were on sale, but the regular price isn't exactly cheap... Still, I'd buy them again.

avis.titre: It adheres nicely to the eye...
avis.texte: It adheres nicely to the eye area with a plump, bouncy texture. The next day after use, my eye area feels noticeably more hydrated. I didn't find any particular drawbacks. If I discover any areas for improvement, I'll make sure to mention them separately!

avis.titre: I gifted this product to my...
avis.texte: I gifted this product to my mother in her 50s, and she said it's been quite effective! I'd recommend this for middle­aged individuals. Well, considering my mother didn't mention any drawbacks, it seems there aren't any notable ones!

avis.titre: I was really impressed by how...
avis.texte: I was really impressed by how generously soaked these patches are with the serum! They're definitely among the top gel­type eye patches I've tried. I was initially worried since I have severe redness on my cheeks, but these didn't cause any irritation at all. There's hardly any scent to it, so it's a safe choice for those sensitive to fragrances. The only downside was that, perhaps due to the abundance of serum, they tended to slip down my face a bit, which was slightly inconvenient.

The product name mentions retinol and collagen, which raises expectations! While I can't speak to its direct effects, applying it feels pleasant, cool, and moisturizing. It seems to help with dryness around the eyes. Even with tweezers, it's challenging to use these types of products one sheet at a time. The adhesion is good, but you need to lie down to prevent it from sliding off and to ensure it stays in place.

My skin type is combination dehydrated and super sensitive. I've used many similar pads before, but they tend to slip off when I'm sitting. So, I've found a trick ­ I stick the toner pad under my iPad to keep it from sliding around! There's nothing particularly disappointing about this product. I'm quite satisfied with both the texture and the finish.

A gel patch that adheres perfectly with a delightfully moist texture! The gel­type formula feels soft and pleasant on the skin. It provides a nice cooling sensation and doesn't dry out quickly, effectively delivering the essence. This is personally my preferred type of product. I bought it not just for the eye area, but also to focus on treating areas with pigmentation like nasolabial folds and around the jawline. It's great for leaving on for extended periods, and being a gel, it's easy to cut and apply to specific areas, even small ones! While I haven't used it long enough to see dramatic firming effects, it provides basic hydration management, leaving the skin plump. The combination of retinol and collagen ingredients seems promising. When my skin barrier is compromised, the thinnest and most vulnerable areas are around my eyes and cheeks. Given the high­performance formula with retinol, I find it a bit concerning to use when my skin is sensitive. It's not that it causes intense irritation, but there is a slight sensation, so I tend to avoid it when my skin is feeling delicate. As long as you don't cut them too small, the pieces still adhere well. You don't have to limit its use to just the eye area ­ you can cut it to fit any area you want to treat using something like a spatula. It's great to apply, go about your daily activities, and remove it when it starts to dry.

avis.titre: I'm on my second bottle now.
avis.texte: I'm on my second bottle now. I love how well it adheres under the eyes without coming off easily. I'm really satisfied that I can take care of my skin without any irritation. I haven't found any major drawbacks while using this product so far.

avis.titre: As a retinol eye patch, it's...
avis.texte: As a retinol eye patch, it's great for caring for the eye area. There's no irritation, so I felt comfortable using it consistently as a preventative measure. Like other eye patches, this product also tends to slide down until the essence is somewhat absorbed.

avis.titre: I love how easy it is to apply...
avis.texte: I love how easy it is to apply these for targeted care around the eyes It's a bit tricky to separate each patch, and I wish the ingredient list was more streamlined
These are hydrating and lightweight eye patches. They're perfect for nighttime skincare. The gel­type formula adheres well to the skin. I didn't find any drawbacks.

The ampoule is generously sized and incredibly hydrating. It's convenient to use with the included spoon, scooping out one capsule at a time. The texture is delightfully bouncy, and I feel like it's giving my skin a noticeable boost in elasticity. At first, the ampoule tends to slide towards the cheeks due to its generous amount, but it settles nicely after a while.

­ Feels refreshingly cool when applied ­ Gel texture minimizes physical irritation ­ Seems to provide a temporary brightening effect ­ Unsure about the long­term benefits of these eye patches. Should I wear them for longer periods?

avis.titre: I bought this to care for my...
avis.texte: I bought this to care for my eye wrinkles and smile lines, and it's pretty good when used occasionally. The ampoule content is quite generous, making it moisturizing and firm. The patch size is perfect for sticking on areas with eye wrinkles or smile lines. The adhesion is just okay. There was no visible wrinkle improvement effect that could be seen with the naked eye in a short period of time.

The adhesion is excellent, so it stays put well. After cleansing and applying skincare, I can leave it on for a long time without any discomfort. I bought it at Olive Young, loved it, and repurchased. When I'm too lazy for a full face mask, it's great to just apply patches to the eye area, forehead, and smile lines. Since it contains retinol, it's better to use before bed rather than during the day. Unlike other retinol essences, it wasn't irritating. However, if you're expecting typical retinol effects like exfoliation or faster skin turnover, I wouldn't recommend it. Since it's an eye patch, they seem to have reduced the retinol content for a gentler formula. It's actually great for comfortably applying to the eye area and smile lines, and I'm using it for deep wrinkle prevention and hydration. Although I don't use it during the day because of the retinol, sometimes when I use it on weekend afternoons, any essence not absorbed by the gel patch can cause pilling if other skincare products are applied. This makes my face feel messy, and I want to wash it again. When using it before bed, I gently wipe away any excess essence with a toner pad. The strong adhesion makes it great for facial yoga­like exercises around the eyes. The patch provides just enough grip on the skin, allowing you to move the muscles with less wrinkle formation!

Even though it contains retinol, it wasn't irritating or tingling at all. It's so convenient for eye care ­ you just need to gently pat it around the eyes. The texture is firm and elastic, causing no irritation, and I loved the slight cooling effect. I was concerned about fine lines around my eyes, but they seem to have faded a bit. It's disappointing that it doesn't adhere well to the eye area and tends to slide down.

It's wonderfully hydrating! The texture is more like a gel mask than a sheet mask, so it adheres perfectly even to contoured areas of the face. I was surprised to find a spoon inside. Since it's a patch and not a cream, I think it should come with tweezers instead. Usually, when I use face masks, the eye area is left uncovered and gets dry. But with this, I can apply the face mask and these patches simultaneously, allowing me to take care of my under­eye area at the same time. It's fantastic!

avis.titre: It's perfect for a quick and...
avis.texte: It's perfect for a quick and easy eye care routine. Sometimes doing a full face mask can be a hassle, but this is so convenient. There's really nothing to complain about. I can't think of any downsides.
The shape is perfect for applying around the eyes and mouth, and the formula is excellent I had to stop using it when I became pregnant because retinol isn't recommended during pregnancy

The material adheres well to the skin and contains a generous amount of ampoule, making it great to use as a mask. It's particularly effective for intensive care on areas that need extra attention, like around the eyes or nasolabial folds. The downside is that I'm already feeling a sense of regret even though I haven't finished using it yet. I have a feeling I'll need to buy more soon. I apply it on my face and also stick it on my neck.

It feels convenient to use, like applying a gel mask specifically to areas like under the eyes or nasolabial folds. It's comfortable and provides good hydration, which I really like. Understandably, using just this patch alone might not be enough to noticeably experience the effects of retinol or collagen.

The eye patches were generously soaked in essence, which I loved. They stayed in place comfortably without sliding down, which was a big plus. I didn't notice any significant changes after using these. Still, I'm planning to keep at it and use them consistently.

When I'm worried about increasing eye wrinkles, using this gives me peace of mind. Being a gel­type patch, it's non­irritating and has a long­lasting cooling effect. There's no noticeable effect, and due to gravity, it gradually slides down, making me wonder if I'm treating my eye area or my cheeks.

I'm using this as a preventative measure. I'll need to use it more to fully assess its effectiveness. It was a bit challenging to keep it in place as it kept slipping. I think I'll need to lie down when using it.
These collagen patches for the eyes don't feel dry even when worn for a long time The patches are small and stick together, making them annoying to separate

avis.titre: I love that these eye patches...
avis.texte: I love that these eye patches come in a jar instead of individual packaging. It's so much better for reducing waste, while still giving you all the benefits of using eye patches. There's not much to complain about. I'll have to use the entire jar to really know for sure.
Great for preventing fine lines. It keeps your skin nicely hydrated. Unfortunately, it doesn't do much for deep wrinkles. Consistent use might yield better results though.

After consistently using it for two weeks, I noticed the area around my eyes looks slightly brighter than before, and it seems to have some effect on fine lines as well. I used it not just around the eyes, but also on my forehead and nasolabial folds. With all these applications, it ran out in just two weeks. You don't have to limit it to just the eye area ­ feel free to use it on any part that needs care!

avis.titre: It's great to just slap it on...
avis.texte: It's great to just slap it on after washing your face and leave it be. You can peel it off before bed! Nothing particularly bad, honestly. Though if you try to use it as an overnight mask, it might dry out a bit.

Mediheal products are fantastic! I love that they work so hard, allowing me to try various items from their range. Mediheal products are amazing! It's such a hardworking brand, and I love that I can try all sorts of products from their line.

avis.titre: The pads adhere really well to...
avis.texte: The pads adhere really well to the skin and have a slight smoothing effect on fine lines. There wasn't anything particularly disappointing. I'm quite satisfied with how it feels on my skin.

avis.titre: I apply these under my eyes...
avis.texte: I apply these under my eyes and on my nasolabial folds. While it's a bit fiddly, it's still more convenient than a full face mask, so I use them regularly. If you use them when they're too wet, they'll slide off. You need to control the amount of essence.

The patches separate easily with the spatula, and I recommend Mediheal as a trusted brand. Despite being retinol patches, they don't irritate the under­eye area or cause any sensitivity. These might not be suitable for those with super sensitive skin around the eyes.

It's wonderfully hydrating, and once absorbed, the jelly pads adhere so well to the skin that they stay put even while sleeping. I found it convenient to simply peel them off in the morning. The spoon that comes with it is a bit awkward to use. I think it would have been better if they included tweezers instead.

As I noticed wrinkles forming and sagging around my eyes, I felt an eye cream alone wasn't enough. So I decided to try something more and purchased this. While I haven't used it extensively yet, it feels hydrating and I'm hopeful for meaningful results. Using it on the eye area, between the brows, and nasolabial folds means it'll run out quickly! It's also suitable for use on nasolabial folds and between the eyebrows.

It's moisturizing and provides excellent hydration. The patches are easy to apply around the eyes. Nothing particularly bad. Maybe a bit pricey? I'll probably stick to buying Mediheal's famous sheet masks.

These jelly patches don't slide off and have a nice, bouncy texture. I love that they're not sticky and absorb well into the skin. The scent is similar to other serums or ampoules with fragrance. I bought them for wrinkle management, so I'll have to compare the before and after once I finish the whole container to see if there's any effect. As mentioned in other reviews, it comes with a spoon instead of tweezers. It seems they opted for a spoon to prevent tearing or slipping, but honestly, both are equally difficult to use for picking up the patches. For best results, use consistently. I've tried various patches, and they all tend to make my face look a bit brighter overall.

The high concentration of serum makes it really hydrating. I love how easy and fuss­free it is to use. It tends to slide down when applied around the eyes while sitting up. If you lie down for a bit, it dries out somewhat.

The ampoule is generously infused, making it incredibly hydrating. It adheres well to the skin, staying in place without sliding or moving once applied. Upon research, I found it's formulated with 95% pure retinol and a 5­fold collagen blend. Moreover, it contains low molecular weight collagen for rapid absorption. A small spoon is included, but it's not as useful as expected. It's inconvenient to peel off each patch individually. I think silicone tweezers would actually be more practical.

It feels plump and adheres well to the face. I liked that there was no uncomfortable residue after use. It seems to cause a bit of irritation. It might be better suited for those with resilient skin rather than those with sensitive skin.

The generous amount of essence keeps skin hydrated, and the sheet's thickness is just right for good adherence to the face. The mask's slightly squishy texture might be surprising for first­time users.
This collagen mask with retinol feels like a two­for­one deal It's a bit harsh for under the eyes, so I'm only applying it to my smile lines

avis.titre: I'm thrilled to have found a...
avis.texte: I'm thrilled to have found a product that seems promising for my concerns about eye and smile lines. I'll need to keep using it, but I'm hopeful it'll be effective! As other reviews mentioned, it slides down unfortunately. You need to lie down after applying the patch. I also apply it to the frown lines between my eyebrows!

avis.titre: It adheres nicely to the skin...
avis.texte: It adheres nicely to the skin with a satisfying texture. The fragrance is also pleasant. I'm definitely considering repurchasing. The price and the fact that it doesn't come off easily are drawbacks. However, I suppose that's unavoidable given the nature of the product.

avis.titre: The large size of the patches...
avis.texte: The large size of the patches is great Provides excellent hydration Stays put well without falling off There's a scent reminiscent of old­fashioned powdery cosmetics No other issues to mention

It's my first time trying these eye ampoule patches, and I'm impressed! They help reduce the heat sensation around my eyes, which is great. The silicone cap inside was too tight, making it uncomfortable to use. I hope they can improve this aspect.

As I'm getting older, I've noticed the under­eye area becoming sunken and the wrinkles around my eyes deepening, which has been a concern. I couldn't use eye creams because they irritated the blemishes around my eyes, so I decided to try these eye ampoule patches for the first time. They contain retinol and collagen, which are said to improve under­eye volume and deep wrinkles while maintaining hydration. The patches are infused with a highly concentrated ampoule, and you can hygienically use one at a time with the included spoon. They can be used on any area with wrinkles ­ forehead, smile lines, etc. Just leave them on for 20­30 minutes. I love that there's plenty of ampoule in each patch! While I'm not sure about the wrinkle­reducing effects yet, I can definitely feel my eye area becoming more hydrated. The quantity is quite small. There are many areas to use it on, but not enough product. One container gets used up quickly.

avis.titre: I was very satisfied with how...
avis.texte: I was very satisfied with how easy it was to use and how well it adhered to my skin There's nothing to complain about. As expected, Mediheal is the go­to brand for patch mask packs It works great when used together with a retinol ampoule

avis.titre: I use these two or three times...
avis.texte: I use these two or three times a week. The next day, I can definitely feel my skin has more bounce and firmness. My makeup also applies better the following day. I'm planning to keep using these eye patches consistently. I'm not sure if they're too thin or what, as I haven't tried other products to compare... But they tear easily. Also, are eye patches supposed to come with a spatula? It's really difficult to use.

avis.titre: I've been using this on my...
avis.texte: I've been using this on my dark circles area! While I'm not sure about its effect on dark circles specifically, it definitely contains collagen, which seems to make my skin feel more plump and firm. I haven't found anything disappointing about it yet. I have a feeling I'll be using this product quite well!
I loved how well these collagen patches adhered to my skin, providing excellent contact Since it contains retinol, those with sensitive skin should use it cautiously

avis.titre: Easy to apply with a quick...
avis.texte: Easy to apply with a quick swipe and stays put well. The ingredients are good too. I'm using them under my eyes and on my nasolabial folds. They're a bit tricky to remove, haha. They included some kind of spoon, but I think tweezers would have been better.

avis.titre: I needed eye patches and got...
avis.texte: I needed eye patches and got them at a great deal price Since I bought them so cheaply, there wasn't anything to be disappointed about

avis.titre: Right after using it, I felt a...
avis.texte: Right after using it, I felt a tightening sensation, making me wonder if it had a lifting effect. I'm writing this after just one use, so I can't say for certain yet. It seems unavoidable that it drips down after applying it over my skincare routine. Also, when I apply skincare products again after removing the mask, it pills. It doesn't seem to absorb well.

avis.titre: This is my first time using...
avis.texte: This is my first time using eye patches, and they're incredibly soft and supple ­ it's like sticking jelly on your face! I think they're effective, so I'm planning to use them consistently every day as part of my daily mask routine. When I have them on my face, there's a slight tingling sensation. They're thin and delicate, so it's surprisingly challenging to apply them using the enclosed spoon. They also tear easily. I find they work even better if you chill them before applying!
While I didn't see dramatic results on existing wrinkles, it leaves my skin feeling firm and supple after use Initially, it tends to slide down, so you need to keep adjusting it

avis.titre: The patches are wide enough to...
avis.texte: The patches are wide enough to cover under­eye and smile lines, which is great. They really adhere to the skin, sticking on snugly ­ I love that! Even though there's a spoon included, it's still quite difficult to remove each patch. I think tweezers would be more convenient.

avis.titre: I bought this because my skin...
avis.texte: I bought this because my skin is thin and my nasolabial folds were becoming more noticeable! I've been applying it to my nasolabial area every other day, and it definitely feels moisturizing. While it doesn't completely eliminate the folds, it seems to prevent them from getting worse. I wish there was a bit more solution ­ sometimes the patches feel less hydrated, which is a bit disappointing. I've thought about storing it upside down, but I'm worried it might leak. Applying cream over the patch can cause some pilling, so I recommend moisturizing well before applying the patch for better results! I have super sensitive skin that easily breaks out with incompatible products, but I've never experienced any blemishes from using this. I have slightly oily skin while my mom has dry skin, and we both use it well, so it seems suitable for all skin types. I recommend it for everyone! Due to the nature of the product, it comes in a jar­type container, which I personally find inconvenient. Especially, I often think I've closed the lid properly, but it keeps opening slightly, causing me to drop it frequently. It would be great if this aspect could be improved! The patches tend to slip if you move around, so I recommend applying them while lying down for about 15 minutes before removing. I've tried sleeping with them on, but they were too dry by morning.

avis.titre: I love how moisturizing it is!...
avis.texte: I love how moisturizing it is! My skin isn't particularly sensitive, so I haven't experienced any blemishes. I'm really enjoying using this product. This is my first time trying it, so I don't have anything to compare it to. However, it meets my expectations, so I don't have any complaints.

Purchased as an eye cream alternative. Surprisingly hydrating, and after removal, there's a temporary but noticeable firming effect on the skin. The amount of ampoule is just right, making it comfortable for regular use without feeling excessive. The patches tend to slide down a bit, requiring occasional readjustment during wear. I apply these eye patches and then layer a sheet mask over them. Even after removing the sheet mask, the eye patches stay firmly in place.

avis.titre: I think I saw some results...
avis.texte: I think I saw some results after applying it near my eyes. I also liked that it has a moisturizing jelly­like texture. The texture is a bit sticky, so if you don't like that kind of consistency, you might not enjoy it. Other than that, I don't see any particular drawbacks, so I think it'll work well for most people.

avis.titre: When I apply it around my...
avis.texte: When I apply it around my eyes, between my brows, and around my mouth in the evening while lying down, I feel my skin becoming firmer without any side effects. The inner lid is quite stiff, making it inconvenient to open and close.

avis.titre: It's fantastic to put this on...
avis.texte: It's fantastic to put this on right before bed! There's a cooling effect that's so refreshing, and it provides hydration without being too rich, so you don't even need a separate eye cream to keep the eye area from getting dry. The best part is that it's packed with so much essence that it doesn't dry out even after wearing it for a good half hour! On days when my skin was super sensitive, I sometimes felt a slight tingling sensation. It usually calms down after a while, but there were times when it stung a bit right when I first applied it.

avis.titre: It adheres really well to the...
avis.texte: It adheres really well to the skin. Once you put it on, it stays put. It feels refreshingly cool. Unfortunately, I didn't see any improvements in hydration, brightening, firmness, or wrinkle reduction. It's disappointing, especially since I usually like Mediheal products. The inner lid can be tricky to close. Instead of pressing around the edges, try pushing down on the center to squeeze out the air. That should help it seal properly.

avis.titre: As someone with dry skin and...
avis.texte: As someone with dry skin and particularly dry eye area, I'm really pleased with this purchase. It's great for targeted care around the eyes. I love that the eye patches are soaked in serum, which doesn't drip or run, making it easy to use. The built­in cap doesn't close easily, though pressing it firmly does the trick. Also, it's a bit challenging to scoop out the product with the spatula.

avis.titre: I tried it as soon as I got...
avis.texte: I tried it as soon as I got it. It's an eye patch with a delightfully firm texture. I applied it before bed and found it wonderfully moisturizing! The lid doesn't open and close properly, which is inconvenient. This is a disappointing aspect.

I love that it's specifically designed for eye wrinkles, making it perfect for daily use after cleansing. It doesn't irritate my eyes and works wonders on fine lines. I wish I'd known about it sooner! I was so worried about my eye wrinkles, and I'm so relieved this product exists. Sometimes I even use it on my forehead. It can be a bit slippery and slide down, but after reapplying and waiting a few minutes, it seems to stay put. In my case, I haven't experienced any blemishes. When I use it before going out and apply makeup without washing it off, the product tends to pill around my eyes. Rubbing it gently with my fingers helps, but it's best to avoid touching it if possible.

1. It feels refreshingly cool when applied. 2. It adheres well to the eye area. 3. The patches seem to be thoroughly soaked in essence, probably due to their material. This gives the impression that they might be even more effective. To be honest, I think this product is more about wrinkle prevention than actual wrinkle improvement. It's disappointing that there weren't any noticeable significant improvements. Also, the container isn't particularly convenient to open and close.
It's moisturizing and nice. I bought it after reading reviews, and I'm satisfied so far. I'm content for now, but the amount... haha!

The half­moon shape covers my entire face, even though I have a smaller face. It's not too small, so it feels refreshing to use. I have dry skin, and there's plenty of essence left over. There's hardly any scent, and it leaves my skin feeling hydrated. While the amount is generous, which is great, the lid was surprisingly difficult to close properly. It's also good to apply on your neck. For an extra cooling effect in summer, try storing it in the fridge. Just keep in mind that frequent temperature changes might not be ideal for the product. It helped reduce redness on my skin.

I've been using this every evening and my skin feels so much more hydrated. I applied it around my eyes, smile lines, forehead, and neck, and the next day my skin had noticeably more moisture and less dryness. It's a bit inconvenient to use as you have to peel off each sheet individually. Sometimes multiple sheets stick together, and towards the bottom, there's too much gel which tends to drip. During winter, using this daily around the eye area instead of eye cream makes your skin feel incredibly hydrated

avis.titre: I apply these under my eyes...
avis.texte: I apply these under my eyes, on my neck, and around my smile lines before bed. While I'm not sure about their effectiveness, I use them occasionally as a preventive measure. I've used up an entire container, but the results don't seem to be particularly dramatic.

It's packed with essence and transparent, so you can go about your day without anyone noticing you're wearing a mask I'm not sure if it's effective. If you don't remove it before it's completely dry, your skin feels even more dehydrated

The adhesion is excellent, and it stays put without falling off or pilling even during daily activities. It's packed with essence and absorbs well into the skin. You can use it daily without any irritation. The lid can be a bit tricky to close. While it seals tightly, sometimes it doesn't align properly on the first try.
My eyebags are better since I stared using retinol collagen patch

The patches become transparent, so you can wear them overnight. After using them, the dry areas seem protected, improving fine lines, complexion, and making skin texture softer. At first, I thought there wasn't much product, but it lasted quite a while when used just around the eyes. Contains retinol, so focusing on one area intensively can lead to redness and sensitivity over time ­ likely due to skin thinning from retinol use. Skin improved when I stopped using it. It's a bit much for daily use, but good for occasional treatments. Especially beneficial when skin feels thick and rough. Difficult to use daily. When the ampoule dries, it peels off like an eraser. Still, I'm using it well on my forehead and around eyes. When eye area itchiness from dryness leads to scratching and slow healing, using Duoderm tape as a protective barrier helped. The eye area seems to take longer to heal due to constant movement.

avis.titre: This is a staple for me! After...
avis.texte: This is a staple for me! After trying this product, I also gave Mediheal's Vita Collagen Eye Patch a go. It gives the feeling of filling in under­eye bags, and even though I have super sensitive skin, I used it without any issues. I repurchased these brown Medihae patches because they're effective at improving wrinkles and plumping up the under­eye area. When the patches are overly saturated with essence, they tend to slip down the skin. I use them under my eyes and on the outer corners for 30 minutes. Then, I take a bit of the remaining essence from the container and apply it to my frown lines. After that, I reuse the patches by placing them on my frown lines for another 30 minutes. It's a great way to get more use out of the patches!
It feels so hydrating and plump, like it's packed with collagen I don't seem to use it often. It's hard to motivate myself to use it despite the hassle

It stays put without sliding off and has excellent adherence. It feels slightly cool and gives a plumping sensation to the skin. There's nothing particularly disappointing, but it would be nice if it were more affordable. I wish they'd release a larger size too.

The container is generously filled with essence, making it pleasantly hydrating and enjoyable to use. Perhaps due to the abundance of essence, the mask doesn't adhere to the skin quite as well as it could.
